newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 19.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 19.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Detailed debate of the 1997 budget has started in parliament.
- Hungary's parties still have ambiguous opinions about the Hungarian-Romanian friendship treaty signed in September.
- Construction workers' trade union urges a pay rise above inflation levels for next year.
- Hungary's leaders are willing to have top-level meetings with the new Romanian government.
- Energy utilities are reported to find insufficient the planned energy price increases.
